body:
- Court Complexes Management: Copy master court complexes as courts for better management.
- Improved Case Import Handling: Added a failure callback for case number imports to ensure smoother operations.
- Error Handling in Case Imports: Refactored caseImportRouter to handle PostgreSQL errors (23505, 22001) gracefully.
- Case Number Input Refactor: Enhanced CaseNumberInput component to improve case number handling with additional validations.
- Manual Case Import Revamp: Refactored ManualCaseImport to a table view, added a status refresh button, and improved the user interface for better visibility.
